title: About IEV
html:
International Electrotechnical Vocabulary (IEV)

The International Electrotechnical Vocabulary (IEC 60050) is the IEC's comprehensive terminology database, also known as Electropedia. It contains definitions for terms used in electrotechnology, organized into over 80 subject areas spanning electrical engineering, electronics, telecommunications, and related fields.

Data Source

This dataset contains {{conceptCount}} concepts sourced from the IEC Electropedia database. Each concept includes multilingual terminology with definitions available in multiple languages.

Content Scope

IEV covers terminology from the full range of IEC technical committees, including:

  • Electricity, magnetism, and electrical circuits
  • Electromagnetic compatibility
  • Power systems and transmission
  • Electronic components and semiconductor devices
  • Telecommunications and fiber optics
  • Lighting and illumination
  • Safety and environmental aspects

Relationship to Standards

IEV terminology definitions are maintained using the Glossarist concept model, which implements:

  • ISO 10241-1 — terminology entry structure
  • ISO 30042 (TBX) — terminology exchange format
  • ISO 25964 / SKOS — thesaurus interoperability
  • ISO 12620 — data category classification
